text: The gate runs its Go harness without the package's own test files, and takes its result only when the step prints it once (#818). The agreement step, and the check one size larger, compiled every _test.go file the package holds into the harness's process, so a TestMain or an init there could print a result line of its own, which the gate took if it came first, and rewrite the recording after the harness wrote it. Those files already ran in the step before and nobody reads them as part of the explorer, so the step removes them from the sandbox's copy first, and a result is taken only from output that holds exactly one, on a line of its own. Every Go project here keeps Init, Try and Abstract in files that aren't tests. Code the package ships still runs in the harness's process, as it must to be explored.
